abstract: Of 156 consecutive patients with malignant tumor of the testis 99 were alive two years after treatment. Of these, 12 had radiation-induced neurologic complications which, in 5 instances, consisted of persisting, wholly or partially disabling paresis in the lower limbs. Five had mild, transient symptoms and had persisting symptoms which were not incapacitating. In all those with disabling symptoms the irradiation dose had been higher than 1 600 reu, corresponding to 54.5 Gy over 6 weeks with daily fractions 5 days a week.
abstract_ja: 精巣悪性腫瘍の患者156例を連続して調査したところ、治療後2年時点で99例が生存していた。このうち12例に放射線誘発性の神経学的合併症が認められ、5例では下肢の部分的または完全な麻痺が持続し、日常生活に障害をきたした。軽度で一過性の症状を呈した者が5例あり、これらは持続したものの障害の程度は軽かった。障害の強い症状が生じた全例で照射線量は1600レントゲン(54.5Gy、週5日の分割照射で6週間)を超えていた。
